# PII detection bench

Generated by `LOCKKIT_PII_BENCH_UPDATE=1 go test -run '^TestBench$' ./pii/`; do not edit.

Masking is best effort. These are the figures of every detector (all enabled, opt-in ones included, matched with `pii.FindInViews`) on a synthetic corpus: `pii/testdata/bench/*.jsonl`, written by `go run ./pii/internal/benchgen -out pii/testdata/bench`. No real personal data.

- **Recall**: share of gold values a match of the same kind covers whole.
- **Precision**: share of matches overlapping a gold value of their kind (1 when the detector matched nothing).
- **Masked**: share of gold values covered whole by any match, whatever its kind: what an agent does not see.

`TestBench` fails when a metric falls below `baseline.json`.
